name: Concussive Snap (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature snaps its jaws, emitting concussive force in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) thunder damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away from the creature, and stops holding its breath, if was doing so. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage, isn’t pushed, and doesn’t lose its held breath. Constructs and objects and structures have disadvantage on the saving throw.
